Laporta et al. 2014 publish analytical fits to the computed state-to-state rate coefficients without specifying an upper temperature validity cutoff. Project use is capped at the preregistered P5-N2 domain, T_e <= 30 eV (mean energy 45 eV). The 0->1 fit is independently cross-checked against JPCRD 2023 recommended cross sections (Table 7; within 6 % for T_e = 0.5-30 eV); higher overtones remain model-supported rather than independently validated. Source-model applicability, not experimental validation.
